title: Medical English 12-13
category: Medical & Dental Questions > Medical English Question

questions.question: Which one of the following pairs is not correct? (Adjective - Verb)
The synonym for "Ascent" is-
questions.explanation: Ascent শব্দের অর্থ উপরে ওঠা। এর কিছু সমার্থক শব্দ হলো: jump, climb, rise, scaling, Jot down অর্থ লেখা বা বর্ণনা করা; further অর্থ আরও; regress অর্থ পূর্বের অবস্থায় ফিরে যাওয়া।

questions.question: He showed - when the danger came.
questions.explanation: Cold shoulder অর্থ পাশ কাটিয়ে যাওয়া বা সাথে না থাকা, অর্থাৎ বাক্যটির অর্থ- বিপদ দেখে সে সরে পড়েছিল। cold feet অর্থ lack of courage (সাহসের অভাব)।

questions.question: Which one of the followings is the correct passive form of the sentence "I can recite the poem"?
options: Recitation of the poem is possible by me
The poem could be recited by me
The poem can be recited by me
Recitation of the poem can be performed by me
questions.explanation: Modal auxiliary (can, may, shall, will, might, should, would, could etc) থাকলে passive করার সময় এগুলোর পর be + v.p.p হয়। বাকিটা voice এর স্বাভাবিক নিয়মেই হবে।

questions.question: Which one of the followings is correct indirect speech of the sentence: He said, "do you know me?"
options: he inquired whether I knew him
He told me that if I knew him
He asked me that whether I knew him
He asked me that if I know him
questions.explanation: Interrogative sentence এর indirect করার সময় say এর পরিবর্তে ask/inquire এবং that না হয়ে if/whether বসবে।

questions.question: Correct adjective of the word "Contempt" is-
questions.explanation: Contempt (ঘৃণা) শব্দটি হলো noun। এর adjective হবে contemptible (ঘৃণ্য) এবং adverb হবে contemptibly (অবজ্ঞার সাথে)।

questions.question: Which one of the followings is the correct negative form of the sentence "Every mother loves her child"
options: Every mother does not like her child
There is no mother who does not love her child
There is no mother but loves her child
questions.explanation: Every এর পরিবর্তে There is no + noun + but / There is no + noun + who+ auxiliary+not+verb.. ব্যবহার করা হয়।

questions.question: Which one of the followings is the correct affirmative form of the sentence "You can not but do it"?
questions.explanation: Can not but থাকলে Affirmative করার সময় can not but এর পরিবর্তে must ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Antonym of the word "Urbane" is-
questions.explanation: Urbane অর্থ মার্জিত, এর বিপরীত Uncouth (অর্থ অমার্জিত)। Rural শব্দের অর্থ গ্রাম্য; shave অর্থ দাড়ি কামানো; sophisticated অর্থ অত্যাধুনিক।

questions.question: The right form of verb (to say) is used in which of the following sentences?
options: I heard him to say this
I heard him to have said this.
questions.explanation: Hear, feel, see, watch etc থাকলে ২য় মূল verb-এর সাথে ing / base verb হয়।

questions.question: The correct sentence is-
options: I saw him and told everything
You should not pride for your health
I shall avail myself of the morning bus.
He took part in the feast and enjoyed.
questions.explanation: B-তে pride for নয়, বরং proud of হবে।

questions.question: The correct translation of "আমার বমি বমি লাগছে" is-
questions.explanation: Feel nausea অর্থ বমি বমি ভাব অনুভব করা।

questions.question: 'He died ____ accident'.
questions.explanation: দূর্ঘটনায় মারা গেলে die by ব্যবহৃত হয়। Die for দেশের জন্য মারা যাওয়া; die of রোগে মারা যাওয়া।

questions.question: The incorrect sentence is-
options: He has a zeal at public work
I was in want of food
The boy is sick for toys
questions.explanation: (B) তে zeal for হবে। Zeal for অর্থ কোনো কিছুর প্রতি প্রবল আগ্রহ বা উৎসাহ।
